title: Termination Notice, Holdover Exit and Pre-Supply Termination - C&I Contract Terms
content:
**§ Ending a contract** - Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts

1. Early termination during a term requires written notice from the customer's authorized signatory; it takes effect on the first scheduled meter read date on or after the notice date plus the termination notice days, 30 calendar days on every Beacon Ridge C&I structure, and that date is recorded as the termination effective date.
2. Ending holdover service takes effect on the first scheduled meter read date on or after the notice date plus the holdover termination notice days.
3. An executed contract may be terminated before supply starts; it closes immediately with the close reason terminated before flow.
4. When the drop completes, the contract closes with the close reason early termination, or holdover ended when it was ended from holdover.
5. When another supplier enrolls the facility or the facility is final-billed, the contract closes with the close reason switched to other supplier or final billed; during a term this is an early termination for fee purposes.
6. A termination notice cannot be withdrawn once the drop has been scheduled.

## Clause no longer in force

The clause that the early termination fee of a contract terminated before supply starts is computed on the full term, as the pre-flow basis provides, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis. The rest of clause 3 remains in force.

## Effective date worked through (hypothetical dates)

Written notice received 10 March 2026; 30 calendar days later is 9 April 2026. With scheduled meter reads on 3 April and 5 May 2026, the termination effective date is 5 May 2026, the first scheduled read on or after 9 April. Had a read been scheduled on 9 April itself, that day would have been the termination effective date.

## Status and close reason

| Event | Status before | Status after | Close reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| written notice of early termination during the term | active | termination pending | none yet |
| notice to end holdover service | holdover | termination pending | none yet |
| drop completes | termination pending | closed | early termination, or holdover ended |
| termination before supply starts | pending enrollment | closed | terminated before flow |
| another supplier enrolls the facility, or a final bill | active or holdover | closed | switched to other supplier, or final billed |

superseded_clauses: the early termination fee is computed on the full term per etf_preflow_basis.
